title: Service or device is going away
description: Broadcast immediately before pwnagotchi.restart(), pwnagotchi.reboot() or pwnagotchi.shutdown(). The client must treat the following disconnect as expected: show the reason, suppress the error banner, and reconnect with backoff.

mode.description: The mode being restarted into. Non-null only when reason is mode_change.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds at which the plugin produced the message.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.
